contract: one font file read from memory; every face of a collection, each opened and loaded at the case's 26.6 pixel height as libass requests it: after libass's GDI face metrics, a REAL_DIM size request

per face and size: the size metrics, libass's ascent and descent, HarfBuzz scale, emboldening strength, PostScript flag, and underline and strikeout bands; a size the face cannot be loaded at is recorded as such
the kerning at the size (FT_KERNING_DEFAULT) of every pair the kern table lists, sorted and unique, nonzero values only
for every glyph its unhinted outline and advance as libass draws it, then that outline emboldened, slanted, and both, every point of every outline; packets count outlines and bytes their points
the file is read before each timed and memory operation; the reference library is created once, outside it
